text:
Dear colleagues,

I want to share a quick safety reminder from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Our work goes smoother when we keep animal welfare, clear communication, and careful checks ahead of convenience. The senior coordinator is already helping us stay consistent, but each of us still needs to watch for small details that can affect a journey.

When reviewing travel documents, please keep an eye on the fit between the booking notes and the animal's needs. <<FACT F082>> If anything looks unclear, pause and confirm before moving ahead. Small mismatches are easier to fix early, and that saves stress for the traveler, the cabin team, and the animal. We should also make sure any special handling notes are easy to see, especially when a pet is nervous, older, or traveling with extra care needs. Ruby has been a good reminder that calm handling and steady checks matter from the desk to the aircraft.

Thanks for the thoughtful work you do every day. A warm, careful handoff helps everyone feel confident, and it supports the safe service we want to give on every trip. Please keep flagging concerns early, and keep putting safety first in every case.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
